claims.measured: audit-store-more query plans (location index for symbol shapes; project index + temp B-tree for path/project shapes; 0.14 ms path, 0.34 ms project page on 206 notes).

claims.measured: door R14 count 2 for the two-file name; REAL-CORPUS multi-file names.

claims.claim: Staleness: output reflects the index as of the last index run; when files changed after indexing, refresh first.
claims.measured: Annotations are stored rows; re-indexing does not change them (only symbol-name resolution can). The generator emits one remediation for every tool. Not editable from this lane.

The visualization badge (src/intelligence/visualization/visualization-engine.ts:868) still matches by name only, so it misses qualified-name notes — shared code, outside this lane; routed.
